The global CONFLICT block can prevent classification even when one independent route is established. This is an additional operational restriction, not a condition stated by the circular. A blocked evaluation must not be interpreted as permission to disregard an established classification basis.

The designation branch has no explicit below-50% guard. This does not change known Boolean outcomes above the threshold, which independently establishes classification. Designation persistence after exposure changes remains unresolved.
No supplied text supports an existing-fund exemption, a classification grace period based on document updates, a home-regulator veto, or automatic designation based solely on a listed risk factor.
